cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your machine brought this signed note back from tomorrow. I've approved preparing a welcome for the visitor who sent it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last live test killed the plant. May I read the new report before we set a place?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to prepare carefully is approved. Put the signed note beside the chair; someone in tomorrow has written to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can see 'no surviving tissue' under your hand. Why are you covering that part?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll have time for the report after the welcome card. Address it to the person who signed. I'll keep that page here; you've finally got a visitor's name to write.

reason: Reread found the addressee was ambiguous and current adverse evidence unknown. Identify a signed sender and an actual visible adverse report fragment; A continues rationing access while directing hopeful work.
